V_YGO_CARDPILE_EXTRA_PILE.title: Extra Deck
V_YGO_CARDPILE_EXTRA_PILE.description: The Extra Deck you brought with you.
V_YGO_SUMMON_NORMAL.title: Summon
V_YGO_SUMMON_NORMAL.description: Summon a card to the field as a monster. When the monster leaves the field, its card goes to the Discard Pile.
V_YGO_SUMMON.title: Summon ({Attack}/{Life})
V_YGO_SUMMON.description: Summon a monster with [blue]{Attack}[/blue] ATK and [blue]{Life}[/blue] HP.
V_YGO_SPECIAL_SUMMON.title: Special Summon
V_YGO_SPECIAL_SUMMON.description: Special Summon. Cards in your Hand that meet their Special Summon conditions can be played for free.
V_YGO_LINK_SUMMON.title: Link Summon
V_YGO_LINK_SUMMON.description: Summon a Link Monster using the required Link Materials. Open your Extra Deck and click a Link Monster to begin.
V_YGO_FUSION_SUMMON.title: Fusion Summon
V_YGO_FUSION_SUMMON.description: Summon a Fusion Monster using the required Fusion Materials. Usually requires a Fusion Spell.
V_YGO_CONTACT_FUSION.title: Contact Fusion
V_YGO_CONTACT_FUSION.description: No Fusion Spell required. Open your Extra Deck and click this monster to Fusion Summon it directly, using only monsters on the field as materials.
V_YGO_XYZ_SUMMON.title: Xyz Summon
V_YGO_XYZ_SUMMON.description: Overlay monsters of the same Level on the field as materials to Summon an Xyz Monster of the corresponding Rank. Open your Extra Deck and click an Xyz Monster to begin.
V_YGO_SYNCHRO_SUMMON.title: Synchro Summon
V_YGO_SYNCHRO_SUMMON.description: Use 1 or more Tuners and 1 or more non-Tuners on the field whose combined Levels equal the target's Level. Open your Extra Deck and click a Synchro Monster to begin.
V_YGO_SEND_TO_GRAVEYARD.title: Sent to the GY
V_YGO_BATTLE_DESTROYED.title: Destroyed by Battle
V_YGO_BATTLE_DESTROYED.description: Triggers when the monster dies from an enemy attack.
V_YGO_ENTER_FIELD.title: On Summon
V_YGO_ENTER_FIELD.description: Triggers when the monster is Summoned to the field.
V_YGO_ACTION.title: Activate
V_YGO_ACTION.description: A monster's active effect that replaces its normal attack. Click the monster to activate it. Once per turn by default.
V_YGO_NAME_AS.title: Card Name
V_YGO_NAME_AS.description: This card's name is treated as [blue]{YgoName}[/blue].
V_YGO_EQUIP.title: Equip
V_YGO_EQUIP.description: The card is equipped to a monster. Some cards have special effects while equipped. When the monster leaves the field, its equips go to the [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
V_YGO_ENHANCE.title: Boost
V_YGO_ENHANCE.description: Increase the target monster's ATK and HP by the specified amounts.
V_YGO_SET_CARD.title: Set
V_YGO_SET_CARD.description: Powers that must be Set cannot take effect or be activated until the next turn.
V_YGO_HAND_ACTION.title: Hand Effect
V_YGO_HAND_ACTION.description: Right-click a card in your Hand to discard it and activate a special effect. You must still pay its Energy cost.
V_YGO_GRAVEYARD_ACTION.title: GY Effect
V_YGO_GRAVEYARD_ACTION.description: Right-click a card in your Discard Pile to activate its special effect.
V_YGO_POWER_ACTION.title: Activate
V_YGO_POWER_ACTION.description: A Power's active effect. Right-click its icon to activate it. Once per turn by default.
V_YGO_XYZ_MATERIAL.title: Xyz Material
V_YGO_XYZ_MATERIAL.description: Materials used for an Xyz Summon.
V_YGO_BANISH.description: Remove equal amounts of Max HP and current HP. Can be lethal and is unaffected by Block or other buffs.
V_YGO_BANISH.title: Banish
